description: This Java source file defines the HibernateSchedulerDAO class, which implements the SchedulerDAO interface for managing scheduled task entities (TaskDefinition) using Hibernate ORM. The class provides methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting tasks from the database, utilizing Hibernate sessions and criteria queries.

classes.name: HibernateSchedulerDAO
classes.description: Implements methods to manage TaskDefinition entities in the database using Hibernate ORM, including create, read, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the Hibernate SessionFactory used by this DAO.

methods.name: createTask
methods.description: Persists a new TaskDefinition entity in the database.

methods.name: getTask
methods.description: Retrieves a TaskDefinition by its internal ID.

methods.name: getTaskByName
methods.description: Retrieves a TaskDefinition by its name using criteria API.

methods.name: getTasks
methods.description: Retrieves all TaskDefinition entities from the database.

methods.name: deleteTask (by id)
methods.description: Deletes a TaskDefinition by its ID.

methods.name: getTaskByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a TaskDefinition by its UUID.
